Founded in 2010, Stripe provides a suite of APIs that enable businesses to process various payment methods, including credit cards, debit cards, and digital wallets, with features like subscription billing, invoicing, and fraud prevention. Its developer-friendly tools, robust security measures, and international currency support have made it a popular choice for businesses of all sizes seeking to streamline their online transactions. Writing blogs in Liferay can feel like an enormous task. The AI tools just draft the content, which needs to be pasted, search for images separately, and the broken HTML and CSS need to be fixed. If all this is right, there comes a task to upload and position images. Once everything is alright, the excitement of the blog is lost. Here is when the AI Blog workspace comes into the picture. Using the tool, now the whole process is inside Liferay. The user can either give a prompt or a title, and it generates the blog and completes the process without leaving the portal. Content and images are created together, and formatting is handled. The blog can be refined in draft using AI tools or rich editors. One of the prominent features of this tool is that it can create a blog based on voice input or text input.

While creating entities using batch extension, the user needs to perform a lot of repetitive manual work. For every single minor change to objects, picklists, roles, or other entities, the developer needs to carefully remember each step. If anything is missed, it leads to breaking the client extension. That’s where our new Batch Extension Generator tool changes the game. It eliminates the hassle of repetitive manual work when setting up client extensions. With just a few clicks, it generates client extensions that include object definitions, object folders, picklists, user roles, and workflows. This makes deployment

quicker, more consistent, and easier, which improves efficiency. It is ideal for developers and administrators who want to work smarter, move faster, and deliver more.

description.en_US:
Bridge Your Portal Data and Marketing Power

The HubSpot Connector for Liferay is a powerful integration tool designed to eliminate data silos. It creates a seamless, automated bridge between your Liferay DXP portal and the HubSpot CRM, ensuring your sales and marketing teams always have the most up-to-date information at their fingertips.

Stop wasting time with manual data exports. By connecting Liferay Objects directly to HubSpot, you can ensure that every new contact, company, or lead captured in your portal is instantly synced and ready for your next automated campaign.

Key Features

  • Automatic Lead Generation Forget manual entry. When a record is added to a specific Liferay Object—whether through a registration form, a lead magnet, or a customer portal—the connector automatically creates the corresponding record in HubSpot.

  • Smart Mapping Engine Technical complexity is handled for you. The connector features a smart mapping layer that manages naming conventions and field normalization between both platforms, ensuring data integrity without requiring custom code.

  • Real-Time Synchronization Your marketing team shouldn't have to wait for "overnight batches." The bridge ensures that data flows to your CRM the moment it is captured in Liferay, enabling immediate follow-up and faster conversion.

  • Seamless Installation Built to live natively within your environment, the application is ready to configure immediately after installation from the Liferay Marketplace.
